summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser as requested. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass: 42 passed under the shared venv Python. Nothing committed; only those two new files appear in git status. Not verified: mypy, black, and ruff are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement, formatting, and import order were checked by reading only. One uncertain choice: the type-ignore on the pytest.raises line in the parametrized test may be unused under mypy and should be dropped if flagged.
